slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "Every list, one row per item?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A, label "A grid": four small cards in a two by two grid with a zigzag eye path; caption "the eye zigzags"
 Card B, label "One per row", circled with a thick orange marker loop and a small hand-written tag "leaning": four long rows stacked, each with a small picture on the left; caption "the eye goes down"
 Card C, label "A table": a ruled table with many thin cells; caption "dense, hard to scan"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: does a Run get a row too?"
Focal point: card B.
slides.notes: Options: Cards in a grid; One full-width row per item; A table. Leaning: the second (JL 261029: "never NxN, make it each row one item"). Still open: Does a Run keep the same row, or only open as a pop-out?

slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "Four things on every row"
One big hand-drawn row card across the middle, with four parts from left to right, each with a small label above:
 "name": a name tag
 "what for": a short line on a note
 "where it stands": a small progress bar with a tick
 "picture": a tiny framed sketch
Below the row, three small grey buttons drawn faintly with a question mark beside them
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: buttons on the row?"
Focal point: the row card.
slides.notes: Options: Its name with its address; One line of what it is for; Where it stands, in words; Its picture. Leaning: all four, nothing else. Still open: Do the buttons sit on the row, or on its own page?

slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "A Run opens over its Task?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A, label "Own page": an arrow leaving one page for another page; caption "you leave the Task"
 Card B, label "A pop-out", circled with a thick orange marker loop and a small hand-written tag "leaning": a small window floating over a page; caption "the Task stays behind it"
 Card C, label "In place": one row stretched open downward; caption "the row grows"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: big results in a pop-out?"
Focal point: card B.
slides.notes: Options: Its own page (the old Run page); A pop-out over its Task; It opens in place, inside the row. Leaning: the second (s32-D04 proposal). Still open: Can a pop-out hold a big result, with tables and figures?
